### Known gaps

- Without a container runtime DDL folding does not type-check column types, DEFAULT / generated-column / ON UPDATE / CHECK expressions, foreign key bodies beyond name resolution, or view queries: that needs the GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL analyzers, which only the emulator holds. ALTER COLUMN ... ALTER IDENTITY, ALTER SEARCH INDEX, ALTER VECTOR INDEX, ALTER PROPERTY GRAPH, PostgreSQL ALTER INDEX SET options, RENAME WITH SYNONYM and ADD ROW DELETION POLICY in PostgreSQL are still kept as verbatim statements (the printed form of their grammar was not available from the DDL reference pages).
